svg.title: gnss-ssv against the Space Service Volume booklet
svg.desc: The recorded comparison of the space-user availability model with the public Space Service Volume booklet, from the committed results of the pre-registered run (xval/gnss-ssv/results-run1.json, written by the ssv_booklet_check example of engine v0.39.0). Bar by bar, the cells within tolerance: S0 13 of 13 (MET); S1 43 of 52 (NOT MET); S2 48 of 52 (NOT MET); S3 122 of 155 (NOT MET); S4 132 of 156 (NOT MET); S5 18 of 26 (NOT MET); S6 26 of 26 (MET); S7 0 of 20 panel patterns (NOT MET). Only S0 and S6 are met under the pre-registered reading. A diagnostic variant that uses the booklet's other GLONASS angles brings S1, S2 and S4 to every cell, but does not replace the run of record. No ledger row is VALIDATED. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
